items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: I must have been with Willy about six months, maybe, not that -- yeah, that's about all.

ctx.x: How long were you with them?
I must have been with Willy about six months, maybe, not that -- yeah, that's about all. I went to Jimmy Lunsford's band, I think.
But Willy's band was pretty good at that time.
